visualCharacteristics.structure: logo | heading + text in a rounded panel

contentPattern: 1 row, 2 cells: logo image (e.g. American Cancer Society logo, alt 'American Cancer Society') | h2 (e.g. 'Proudly supporting') + paragraph(s), links allowed. A logo paragraph at the top of a single cell also works. The panel surface is part of the block; no section style is needed.
